source.method: manual comparison of unit page and directly linked equipment, magic item, mount and special rule pages

configuration.availabilitySummary: May be included in a High Elf Realms army composition list that offers White Lions of Chrace. Must be fielded as presented, except for the expressly listed optional Chieftain's Chariot.

equipment.name: Chayal
equipment.summary: May re-roll natural rolls of 1 To Hit made during the Combat phase.

equipment.name: The Pelt of Charandis
equipment.summary: Improves armour value in combat and against non-magical shooting, and grants Regeneration (5+).

specialRules.name: Elven Reflexes
specialRules.summary: Korhil (not his mount) gains +1 Initiative, to a maximum of 10, in the first round of combat.

specialRules.name: Furious Charge
specialRules.summary: Korhil gains +1 Attack in a turn when he charged 3 inches or more; this does not apply to his mount.

specialRules.name: Mighty Constitution
specialRules.summary: Korhil gains +1 Strength in a turn when he charged 3 inches or more and is immune to Poisoned Attacks; To Wound rolls still occur normally.

specialRules.name: Move Through Cover
specialRules.summary: Korhil ignores difficult/dangerous terrain Movement modifiers and may re-roll 1s on Dangerous Terrain tests; this rule does not apply to his mount.

specialRules.name: Stubborn
specialRules.summary: A qualifying Stubborn unit can forgo its first Break test and Fall Back in Good Order. A Stubborn character cannot use it while joined to a non-Stubborn unit.

specialRules.name: Valour of Ages
specialRules.summary: May re-roll failed Panic tests from heavy casualties or a friendly unit fleeing through.

equipment.name: Claws and fangs (counts as hand weapon)

specialRules.name: Armour Bane (1, Chracian Lions only)
specialRules.summary: Natural 6 To Wound improves Armour Piercing by 1; Chracian Lions only.

specialRules.name: Close Order
specialRules.summary: The unit may adopt Close Order formation.

specialRules.name: Elven Reflexes
specialRules.summary: Applies to the model with the rule, not its mount; do not assign the benefit to the whole chariot indiscriminately.

specialRules.name: Fear
specialRules.summary: Enemy units may face Leadership checks or To Hit penalties in the rule's specified circumstances.

specialRules.name: First Charge
specialRules.summary: On this unit's first successful charge of the game, its charge target is Disrupted until the end of that turn's Combat phase.

specialRules.name: Impact Hits (D6, Chieftain's Chariot only)
specialRules.summary: D6 Impact Hits from the chariot component only, on a charge of at least 3 inches while in base contact.

specialRules.name: Stubborn
specialRules.summary: May Fall Back in Good Order rather than taking the first qualifying Break test; subject to restrictions.

specialRules.name: Valour of Ages
specialRules.summary: May re-roll certain failed Panic tests.

interpretationChecks.summary: Heavy armour 5+ becomes 4+ in combat and 3+ versus non-magical shooting before other modifiers; no pelt armour improvement is specified for magical shooting.
The Pelt grants Korhil Regeneration (5+). This is a separate recovery roll, not an armour-value improvement.
With Korhil's base Strength 4, Chayal is Strength 6 normally; Mighty Constitution makes it Strength 7 during a qualifying charge turn.
The Korhil unit page explicitly excludes the chariot mount from Furious Charge and Move Through Cover.
The optional Chieftain's Chariot costs 105 additional points and has separately listed models, attacks and rules; do not overwrite Korhil's foot profile with the chariot's component values.
